title: Idle Work

missing.title: Agent not found
missing.body: This device no longer has this Agent

offline: The Machine is offline, so Idle Work can't change now

empty.title: No Idle Work yet
empty.body: Write what the Agent should do on its own when nobody needs it, or wait for it to propose some.

draft.heading: The Agent proposes
draft.footer: Tap to read, change and choose which to keep. Nothing runs until you save.
draft.sheetFooter: Proposals you leave out are dropped when you save.

pieces.heading: On the list
pieces.ordered: Runs top to bottom; drag the handle on the right to reorder. A done piece leaves the list; a repeating one waits again.
pieces.oldestFirst: The piece waiting longest goes first. A finished piece leaves the list; a repeating one waits again.

settings.footer: Starts once the Agent has been quiet this long, one piece at a time. A piece that runs out of time ends as if stopped. Messages that arrive meanwhile wait their turn. Nobody watches these rounds, so they ask for no Approval.

delete.title: Delete this list?
delete.message: {{name}} won't work on its own anymore. Tasks it already did stay.

authenticate.run: Have {{name}} do the next piece now
authenticate.share: Let background work for {{name}} use {{percent}}% of its Budget

tooMany.title: Too long
tooMany.body: A list holds up to 50 pieces.

piece.placeholder: Write the missing tests for the parser
piece.footer: What the Agent does on its own, as one Task
piece.repeatDetail: Goes back to wait instead of leaving the list
piece.missing: This piece is no longer on the list

remove.title: Remove this piece?
remove.message: Tasks it already ran stay. If it is the last piece, the list goes too.

piece.retryFooter: This piece waits for you. It goes back in line where it is.
